item.title: Brighton draw with West Ham
item.description: Brighton scored a late equaliser to rescue a 1-all draw with West Ham in the Premier League. It moves them within two points of the top four and keeps the Londoners in the relegation zone. Advertisement

item.title: Chelsea suffer first defeat in WSL
item.description: Chelsea have suffered a first defeat in this year's Women's Super League. Goalkeeper Courtney Brosnan played a key role as Everton held on to beat the champions 1-0. The Republic of Ireland international is the first keeper to keep a clean sheet against the Blues in over a year. Advertisement The defending champions are now six points behind leaders Manchester City - who were 3-nil winners at Leicester.

item.title: Kerry records most very wet days in Ireland during November
item.description: Kerry recorded the highest number of very wet and dull days in the country last month. That’s according to Met Éireann’s climate statement for November. It shows Valentia Observatory recorded nine very wet days; these are days with 10 or more millimetres of rainfall. Advertisement 13 dull days were recorded at the South Kerry weather station during the eleventh month of the year; a dull day is one with less than half an hour of sunshine. item.title: KCC present Kerry premiere of "Daniel O'Connell: The Emancipator"
item.description: Kerry County Council will be presenting a documentary screening to mark the 250th anniversary of the birth of Daniel O'Connell. "Daniel O'Connell: The Emancipator" is narrated by Domhnall Gleeson, and the screening will take place in Siamsa Tire on December 10th. This is the Kerry premiere of the documentary, and will follow a live music performance by Colm Mac Con Iomaire. item.title: Celtic lose against Hearts
item.description: Hearts have opened up a three-point lead at the top of the Scottish Premiership after winning 2-1 at Celtic. They'd gone into the match at Parkhead ahead of the defending champions on goal difference. It's a defeat for Frenchman Wilfried Nancy in his first game in charge of the Glasgow club. Advertisement

item.title: Connacht lose at Ospreys
item.description: Connacht let a 21 point lead slip to suffer a defeat in their opening Challenge Cup game. The visitors couldn't hold on and lost 24-21 to the Ospreys this evening. Connacht went down to 13 players in the second half allowing the hosts to come back. Advertisement
